notes.title: Heatwave Update Now Live! 35+ New Songs, Free Weekend & 50% Off
notes.notes:
One year ago, Electronauts brought the high-vibe energy of electronic remixing to VR, and quickly became one of the medium's most innovative, critically-acclaimed music experiences. Today, we welcome you BACK to the jam with the Heatwave Update, now LIVE!

Featuring 35+ fresh new jams—including tracks from Childish Gambino,  Giraffage, JMSN, Kygo, and TOKiMONSTA—the Heatwave Update will help you  chill out in these dog days of summer. Here's the full artist lineup (and for those of you keeping score, Electronauts now has a total of 80+ songs from over 80 artists!):

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31461134/2cde19627bcbe3742eb71ab04a044e19a88fea39.jpg

We're celebrating this brand-new content update with an Electronauts Steam Free Weekend, starting NOW through Sunday, August 18, at 11:59pm PDT! Plus, pick up Electronauts for 50% off on Steam during the Free Weekend!

notes.title: Jam with Monstercat in the First Electronauts Content Update, Now Live!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31461134/939fe0715c411e0bee85f2a8b79a652d41b1e62d.png

From the EDM masterminds behind the pulsing Rocket League soundtrack comes Electronauts’ first awesome new song expansion pack: the Monstercat update! Jam out now with four free tracks from their acclaimed catalog:

Bad Computer - "Disarray"
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ak6ynwcCv1Q
Haywyre - "Memory"
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i82fsHN5CPs
Snails & Pegboard Nerds - "Deep in the Night"
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a5FkPFzyKs0
Droptek - "Inject"
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dMZNdBdheqQ
Plus, Monstercat is looking to see what you can make with their music! Share and tag your freshest Monstercat remixes on Survios' social channels (Twitter and Instagram) for a chance to be featured on Survios’ social channels.

Finally, Electronauts v1.1 patches some issues helpfully reported to us from launch, so enjoy these fixes and get back to beatmaking!

Patch Notes for Electronauts v1.1 (released September 4, 2018)

Monstercat Songs: Added four new songs by artists from the label Monstercat: "Disarray" by Bad Computer, "Memory" by Haywyre, "Deep in the Night" by Snails & Pegboard Nerds, and "Inject" by Droptek
Quick Match: Added player count info on Quick Match wait screen
Offline Mode: Fixed a bug that prevented players from playing in offline mode Steam/Oculus
FX Buttons: Fixed transition FX buttons not properly resetting their position after being pressed and switching decks
Tutorials: Fixed audio doubling up in tutorials
Arrangement Tool Save Data: Fixed an issue with the arrangement tool that caused save data to be erased after a patch
Arrangement Tool Reset: Fixed reset of arrangement tool if undocked during menu pop-up transition
